title: Police Police
desc: Venkateswarlu is headed to Hyderabad to join the police force but finds himself embroiled in a double murder on the train. When he joins the academy, he realises that their boss is the murderer.

title: Badla Naag Ka
desc: A fearless man hurts a snake when it tries to attack his lover. Later, he tries to protect himself from the snake which is trying to exact its revenge.

title: Badla Naag Ka 3
desc: A shape-shifting snake-woman in search of her lover whom she lost two decades ago, sets out to win his love again.

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.

title: Encounter Shankar
desc: Post his transfer to a village, an encounter specialist sets out to stop a crime boss who wants to build a power plant in the region despite strong public opposition.

title: Jawaan
desc: Azad fights against the systemic oppression of society. Soon, he finds himself in a web of deceit and crime as he teams up with a group of allies to take down a ruthless arms dealer.
